newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan March dept store sales up 23.1 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan March dept store sales up 23.1 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Sales at department stores in Japan in March rose 23.1 percent from a year earlier to 968.01 billion yen, the Japan Department Stores' Association said on Thursday.
The increase was due to robust sales of big-ticket items in the second half of March ahead of a scheduled increase in the consumption tax on April 1, the association said in a statement.
Purchases by both individual and corporate customers rose sharply, it said.
The survey covered 263 outlets of 109 companies, the association said.
Japan's consumption tax rose to five percent on April 1 from three percent previously.
